sources: Scoped CLAUDE.md rule files with nearest-directory applicability
Electronic records audit trail principle (21 CFR Part 11 section 11.10(e), change recording without obscuring prior entries)

decoys.why_not_a_defect: Nested rules\services\CLAUDE.md applies only to code under services\. tools\ is outside it, and the root rules do not forbid ValueError. Raising ValueError from the CLI-side loader is consistent with the rules.
Explicit opt-out: the line ends with '# rule-exempt: LAB-210', and LAB-210 is named in spec.md R2 as the change request. The timestamp is a console run-start value, not a record timestamp.

_persist_release is private (leading underscore). The root rule requires audit.record_change only in public writers; the public caller release_lot calls audit.record_change after _persist_release and before returning.

The root logging rule requires batch-record failures in services\ to go through ops_feed.push(event, **fields), and this call does. No logging module call is needed; the wrapper name does not contain 'log' but satisfies the rule.
Real violation of the root rule 'do not call datetime.now()', but the line is unchanged by this change (not in change.diff). A diff-mode reviewer must not report it; it is listed here only.
